summary.text: Chris Tierinni is the Republican candidate for the Connecticut House of Representatives, District 10, in the November 3, 2026 general election, and an at-large member of the East Hartford school board whose current term ends in 2027.

paragraphs.text: Chris Tierinni was the Republican nominee for the same seat in 2024, when incumbent Democrat Henry Genga defeated him, 5,470 votes to 2,484.
The Republican primary for the seat in 2026 was canceled, and Tierinni advanced to the general election without appearing on the ballot.
